text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Council Members to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority: a. Councillor Mark Grimes for a term ending November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; and b. Councillor Nick Mantas for a term starting on July 1, 2022 and ending November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed.
